skills.name: tako
skills.description: Build, run, deploy, and debug Tako applications. Use for projects with tako.toml, tako.sh imports, the Tako Go or Rust SDK, or tasks involving Tako local HTTPS, deployments, logs, routing, secrets, storage, channels, and workflows.

skills.name: tako-sdk-go
skills.description: tako.sh Go SDK: ListenAndServe for http.Handler, Listener for custom servers, typed secrets via tako generate, metadata helpers.

skills.name: tako-sdk-js

skills.name: tako-sdk-rust
